mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire serialisation format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) as the serialisation format for internal messages. It was chosen for its better handling of type information across protocol versions. The decision applies to internal message exchanges, not to external APIs.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md
